newsitem.title: UK: MSAS Cassin opens Irish logistics centre.
newsitem.headline: MSAS Cassin opens Irish logistics centre.

text.p: MSAS Cassin, part of International freight forwarders MSAS Cargo International has opened a new 44,000sq. ft. logistics centre at Furry Park, Santry, Dublin, Ireland costing 3 million stg.

In addition to being C bonded for customs, the new centre incorporates a full computerised warehouse and specialist dedicated areas for the provision of value added services. It is located close to Dublin airport and the M1 and M50 motorways.

"In addition to enhancing our core freight management services, this new facility gives up the scope to adopt the latest manufacturing principals for the provision of a variety of value added services," said MSAS Cassin director Micheal O'Donoghue. - Air Cargo Newsroom Tel+44 171 542 7706 Fax+44 171 542 5017
